provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled fully observed decay I(t)=sum A_i*exp(-t/tau_i), t>=0, with constant detector response and no background or instrument convolution. Initial amplitudes are not automatically molecular fractions because component radiative brightness is not supplied.
definitions: Amplitude-weighted lifetime=sum(A*tau)/sum(A). Integrated photon fractions=A_i*tau_i/sum(A*tau). Mean photon arrival time=integral(t*I)/integral(I)=sum(A*tau^2)/sum(A*tau). Distinguish these two lifetime summaries; neither determines molecule fractions without brightness information.
scope: Decay-observation moments, not assignment of named molecular species, kinetics of interconversion or a general fluorescence lifetime fit.
